'''Doug Ford endor walker operations''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Doug Ford]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15341">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15341 endor walker operations], DeckTech (doug "froggy" ford, 17 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15341/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15341/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Doug Ford]]
* '''Published:''' 17 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''endor walker operations''

== Original post ==

'''endor walker operations'''
* '''Author:''' doug "froggy" ford
* '''Published:''' April 17, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' control endor with walkers while draining in space

=== Strategy ===

ok pretty basiuc here guys. on turn one drop characters on endor. and drop down omnious rumors and establish secrt base (via objective). put intruder missiles back ind eck via reactor terminal. i need help making this deck better. please help. thank you
